blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo contrastar ideias numa palestra com even though, despite, in spite of e whereas.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

frames.title: Reading · A lecture and podcast transcript

blocks.title: Podcast: Career Myths
paras: Welcome back. **Even though** many people believe job-hopping hurts a career, some of the best-paid managers have changed jobs often. **Despite** the risks, a move can bring growth, **whereas** staying too long may slow it down.
**In spite of** having less experience, young candidates often learn faster. But **although** change is exciting, it needs a plan.

items.q: The host says job-hopping always hurts a career.
Staying too long may slow growth.

rows: **Even though it is risky, I will go.**
**Despite the risks, a move can help.**
**Despite the fact that he is young, he leads.**

blocks.body: Cuidado: **despite of** não existe. Diga **despite** ou **in spite of**.
Não use but junto com although: ~~Although it is hard, but I try~~.

items.s: ___ though it is risky, I will go. (Even)
___ the risks, a move can help. (Despite)
In ___ of having less experience, she learns fast. (spite)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Some people stay whereas others leave

body: **Jump ship.** — Mudar de lado/de empresa.
**Climb the corporate ladder.** — Subir na hierarquia.
**On the other hand,…** — Por outro lado,…
**Easier said than done.** — Mais fácil falar do que fazer.
**It’s a gamble.** — É uma aposta.
**Play it safe.** — Jogar seguro.
**Weigh up the options.** — Avaliar as opções.
**Some people stay, whereas others leave.** — Alguns ficam, enquanto outros saem.
**Even though job-hopping is risky, I’m thinking about it.** — Embora trocar de emprego seja arriscado, estou pensando nisso.
**Despite the risks, a move can bring growth.** — Apesar dos riscos, uma mudança pode trazer crescimento.

lines: Even though job-hopping is risky, I’m thinking about it.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences about job changes with even though, despite and whereas.
blocks.model: Even though job-hopping is risky, many people do it. Despite the risks, a move can bring growth. Some workers stay for years, whereas others change every two. In spite of having less experience, young candidates learn fast. Although change is exciting, it needs a plan.
